decisions.name: Use Event-Driven Microservices Architecture for OnlineFoodOrderingSystem
decisions.rationale: To achieve high scalability, high availability, medium latency, high reliability, and eventual consistency, the system should be designed as a collection of loosely coupled microservices that communicate with each other using events.

decisions.name: Implement User Registration and Authentication as a separate microservice
decisions.rationale: To ensure high reliability and security, user registration and authentication should be handled by a dedicated microservice that can be scaled independently.

decisions.name: Use a message broker to handle event communication between microservices
decisions.rationale: To achieve high availability and scalability, a message broker like Apache Kafka or RabbitMQ should be used to handle event communication between microservices.

decisions.name: Implement a load balancer to distribute traffic across multiple instances of each microservice
decisions.rationale: To achieve high availability and scalability, a load balancer should be used to distribute traffic across multiple instances of each microservice.

decisions.name: Use a caching layer to improve performance and reduce latency
decisions.rationale: To improve performance and reduce latency, a caching layer like Redis or Memcached should be used to store frequently accessed data.

decisions.name: Implement a real-time order tracking system using WebSockets or Server-Sent Events
decisions.rationale: To provide real-time order tracking, a system using WebSockets or Server-Sent Events should be implemented to push updates to users as soon as they occur.

decisions.name: Use a payment gateway to handle online payments
decisions.rationale: To ensure secure and reliable online payments, a payment gateway like Stripe or PayPal should be used to handle payment processing.

decisions.name: Implement a notification system to send order updates to users
decisions.rationale: To keep users informed about their order status, a notification system should be implemented to send updates to users as soon as they occur.

components.name: User Service
components.responsibility: Handles user registration, authentication, and profile management.

components.name: Restaurant Service
components.responsibility: Manages restaurant information, menus, and order processing.

components.name: Order Service
components.responsibility: Processes food orders, handles payment, and tracks order status in real-time.

components.name: Payment Gateway
components.responsibility: Facilitates online payments through various payment methods.

components.name: Notification Service
components.responsibility: Sends order notifications to users via email, SMS, or other channels.

components.name: Database
components.responsibility: Stores and retrieves data for all components.

components.name: API Gateway
components.responsibility: Routes incoming requests to the respective components and handles authentication.

components.name: Web Application
components.responsibility: Provides a user-friendly interface for users to interact with the system.
